title: 文远知行韩旭：全球市场巨大，覆盖所有允许进入的市场？
speaker: Tony Han

segments.en: Let's start with Oversee's revenue because as you mentioned, it's growth nearly tripled in the third quarter.
segments.zh: 我们先从文远知行的营收说起，正如你提到的，第三季度增长接近两倍。

segments.en: Do you see your international markets becoming more of a main revenue driver for you versus domestically now?
segments.zh: 你认为现在海外市场是否会比国内市场成为更主要的收入来源？

segments.en: Yes, I think we think that the global market becomes more and more important.
segments.zh: 是的，我们认为全球市场正变得越来越重要。

segments.en: The reason is like if you look at the global market, you know, the company that, the autonomous driving company that is capable of delivery robust and safe and convenient
segments.zh: 原因在于，放眼全球，能够提供稳健、安全、便捷的自动驾驶出租车服务的公司

segments.en: global taxi service to cover the global market, there are only very few like 304.
segments.zh: 覆盖全球市场的，只有少数几家，比如304家。

segments.en: But the global market is huge and we actually considering cover all the global market that is allowed us to enter and also I still every time I mention about the regulatory issues
segments.zh: 但全球市场巨大，我们正考虑覆盖所有允许我们进入的全球市场，而且我每次都会提到监管问题

segments.en: and I want to mention like this is a regulatory issue is kind of very, very important and we write this as actually have very rich experience in talking with regulators and convinced regulators
segments.zh: 我想强调，监管问题非常重要，我们在这方面有丰富经验，与监管机构沟通并说服他们

segments.en: with our track record and this become our vote mode.
segments.zh: 凭借我们的过往记录，这成为我们的投票模式。

segments.en: And we are very optimistic about global market, therefore, you know, if you look at numbers, we will put more resource to bring global taxi to everyone.
segments.zh: 我们对全球市场非常乐观，因此，从数字上看，我们将投入更多资源，把自动驾驶出租车带给所有人。

segments.en: I believe global taxi can really change our people's life.
segments.zh: 我相信自动驾驶出租车能真正改变人们的生活。

segments.en: Yeah, and Tony, talk us through this 3000 binding global taxi contracts, right?
segments.zh: Tony，请给我们讲讲这3000份全球出租车约束性合同，好吗？
